# How much of my agency day rate do I actually keep?

> Free UK umbrella company calculator for 2026/27: enter your agency day rate and see employer NI, umbrella margin, tax, NI and take-home pay per day, week and month, plus the day rate you need for a target. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
